insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (as per Policy Schedule / Schedule of Coverage)

great.name: Sum Insured Rebound
great.quote:
6. Sum Insured Rebound
We will add to the Sum Insured, an amount equivalent to the Claim amount paid under Basic Sum Insured,subject to maximum of Basic Sum Insured on subsequent Hospitalization of the Insured Person during Policy Year
great.reference: Section B > III Optional Covers > 6. Sum Insured Rebound (page 15)
great.explanation: An optional cover adds back Sum Insured equal to the claim paid from the Basic Sum Insured, up to 100% of the Basic Sum Insured, for subsequent hospitalizations in the same policy year. This can protect you if you have multiple hospitalizations in a year and the base Sum Insured gets used up.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay for the Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred during the 60 days immediately before Hospitalization of an Insured Person
good.reference: Section B > I Hospitalization Cover > 4. Pre-hospitalization cover (page 10)
good.explanation: Pre-hospitalization medical expenses are covered for up to 60 days before hospitalization. This helps pay for consultations, tests, and medicines leading up to admission.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay for the Post-HospitalizationMedical Expenses incurred upto180 days from the date Insured Person is discharged from Hospital
good.reference: Section B > I Hospitalization Cover > 5. Post-Hospitalization cover (page 10)
good.explanation: Post-hospitalization medical expenses are covered for up to 180 days after discharge. This reduces out-of-pocket costs for follow-ups, medicines, and recovery-related treatment.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 48 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.reference: Section C > 1.I Waiting Periods > i) Pre-existing Diseases – Code – Excl01 (page 19)
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered only after 48 months of continuous coverage from the first policy start date with the insurer. This is a common 4-year waiting period, so PED-related claims before that can be rejected.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatmentsshall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy with us.
good.reference: Section C > 1.I Waiting Periods > ii) Specified Disease/Procedure waiting period – Code – Excl02 (page 19)
good.explanation: Listed specified diseases/procedures are covered only after 24 months of continuous coverage from the first policy start date. This means claims for those listed conditions in the first 2 years can be excluded.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote:
30-day waiting period – Code – Excl03
Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident... This exclusion shall not, however, apply if the Insured Person has continuous coverage for more than twelve months.
good.reference: Section C > 1.I Waiting Periods > iii) 30-day waiting period – Code – Excl03 (page 20)
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered for the first 30 days from the first policy commencement date, but accidents are covered immediately. The exclusion does not apply if the insured has continuous coverage for more than 12 months.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Insured Person shall bear specified percentage of admissible Claim amount under each and every Claim If Co-payment is applicable
bad.reference: Section B > I Hospitalization Cover (repeated across benefits, pages 10-11)
bad.explanation: A co-payment can apply, meaning you may have to bear a specified percentage of every admissible claim when it is applicable. This is a red flag because it can reduce every claim payout, and the exact percentage is not stated in the quoted clause.

unclear.name: Room Rent
unclear.quote: Room rent, boarding and Nursing charges
unclear.reference: Section B > I Hospitalization Cover > 1. Medical Expenses (page 10)
unclear.explanation: Room rent is listed as covered under medical expenses, but the wording here does not state any room category limit or daily cap. The actual room rent restriction (if any) would materially affect claim payouts, so it needs confirmation from the schedule/terms not shown here.

unclear.name: No Claim Bonus
unclear.quote: Cumulative Bonuswill be reduced at the same rate as accrued in the event of admissible Claim under Section B-I of the Policy.
unclear.reference: Section B > II Renewal Benefits > 2. Cumulative Bonus (page 11)
unclear.explanation: Cumulative Bonus is reduced by the same rate as it was accrued when an admissible claim is made. The reduction amount/step is not provided in the quote, so the impact on your future Sum Insured increase cannot be quantified from this extract.
